title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps:
Start the rice.
Slice the steak thin,
toss with cornstarch + soy

Sear the beef hot,
1-2 min a side,
set it aside

Broccoli in, then beef
+ the sauce, toss
until thick and glossy
vo: Beef and broccoli, better than takeout, in thirty minutes.
You need flank steak, broccoli, soy sauce, oyster sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and rice.
Start the rice. Slice the steak thin and toss it with a little cornstarch and soy sauce.
Sear the beef over high heat, one to two minutes a side, then set it aside.
Steam the broccoli in the same pan, add the beef and the sauce, and toss until it's thick and glossy.
